seasons.overview: A high school chemistry teacher begins manufacturing methamphetamine after a life-changing diagnosis.
major_turning_points: Walter and Jesse form an uneasy partnership.
The pair face escalating danger from local distributors.
Walter increasingly accepts a criminal identity to protect his family financially.
seasons.ending_status: Walter has crossed major moral lines and is committed to expanding the operation.
seasons.next_season_hook: The business grows, drawing stronger competition and greater risk.

seasons.overview: The drug operation expands, relationships deteriorate, and consequences become harder to contain.
major_turning_points: Walter and Jesse scale production while struggling with trust.
Walter's decisions trigger far-reaching collateral damage.
seasons.ending_status: The fallout reaches beyond the core characters and signals a darker phase ahead.
seasons.next_season_hook: A more organized criminal world emerges, forcing new alliances and enemies.

seasons.overview: A documentary crew captures awkward day-to-day life in a paper company branch.
major_turning_points: Michael's leadership style creates recurring workplace tension.
Jim and Pam's bond is established through small, meaningful moments.
Team morale fluctuates under uncertainty about company direction.
seasons.ending_status: The office dynamic is set, with early conflicts and relationships clearly in motion.
seasons.next_season_hook: Longer arcs deepen romance, rivalry, and the cost of staying comfortable.

seasons.overview: With more time and confidence, the branch's relationships and ambitions become more layered.
major_turning_points: Jim and Pam's unresolved feelings intensify.
Dwight seeks status and authority with mixed results.
Michael alternates between insecurity and sincere care for the team.
seasons.ending_status: Several relationships reach emotional turning points without full resolution.
seasons.next_season_hook: Career choices and romantic decisions begin to force major life changes.

seasons.overview: A small town investigates a disappearance while confronting mysterious supernatural forces.
major_turning_points: The group of friends uncovers signs of a hidden parallel threat.
A girl with unusual abilities becomes central to the search.
Families and local authorities collide over competing explanations.
seasons.ending_status: The immediate crisis is contained, but evidence suggests the danger is not fully gone.
seasons.next_season_hook: Residual effects and unresolved mysteries reopen the conflict.

seasons.overview: The town deals with lingering trauma as a broader threat emerges from the same supernatural source.
major_turning_points: Characters face personal aftereffects from the prior season.
New alliances form to respond to an expanding threat.
The group coordinates a high-stakes defense of the town.
seasons.ending_status: A temporary victory restores calm while hinting at a much larger conflict.
seasons.next_season_hook: The enemy's scale appears greater than previously understood.
